subject: Software Engineering
moduleTitle: Unit 4 — Stacks, Storage Architectures & Expression Parsing Mechanics
moduleDescription: Comprehensive engineering study of the Stack Abstract Data Type (ADT): LIFO formal invariants, contiguous array vs heap-allocated linked node storage topologies, Dijkstra's Shunting-Yard Infix-to-Postfix conversion, Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) evaluation engines, runtime activation call stacks, and backtracking state machines.
